summary: ThermoIntel API regression suite passed 2/2. UI dashboard, map, Gujarat scope change, investigation panel, all navigation views, FIRMS unavailable state, and responsive layout were exercised. Analyst integration is configured in this environment and returned a grounded response.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid=thermal-map is present on a hidden duplicate div while the visible Leaflet map has no matching test id; strict visibility-based automation fails on the hidden node.

action_items: Move data-testid=thermal-map onto the visible Leaflet map container or use a distinct visible wrapper; remove the hidden duplicate hook.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API calls correctly use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and backend excludes Mongo _id from returned documents.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing synthetic fixtures were used and remained labeled DEMO DATA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested API endpoints and primary dashboard flows covered. Retest the thermal-map test hook after moving it to the visible map. Analyst was tested with configured Emergent integration; no secret was exposed.
rca of the issue: The App renders the React-Leaflet MapContainer with data-testid, but React-Leaflet does not forward that prop to the actual DOM container. A second hidden div with the same data-testid was added as a workaround, causing locator visibility/strictness failure. Use a visible wrapper test id or select .leaflet-container.
